description: Adopts a Unity Hub-started (or otherwise externally-started) editor for this checkout before every Unity MCP tool call, by copying its status file into <checkout>/.unity-mcp so the checkout-local status-dir isolation contract picks it up. Harmless, silent no-op on any other project or when nothing needs adopting - Claude Code only, see skills/unity-wrapper/SKILL.md's Unity Hub adoption section for the Codex equivalent (run scripts/unity-mcp-adopt.ps1 by hand).
